name: Konformia Shop Scanner: Accessibility, Trackers, Checkout
author: immsch

sections.description:
The plugin has two parts.

1. A free check at konformia.at. On request, the plugin sends this
shop’s address to konformia.at and shows the numbers from the check: points
to fix, notes, confirmed points and points that could not be checked, plus a
link to the report. The report shows every finding with where it was found
and how much work it is. Checked:

  • Accessibility: automated test (axe-core, WCAG 2.1 AA) on the home page, a
    product page and the checkout, and whether an accessibility statement
    exists (European Accessibility Act, Directive (EU) 2019/882)
  • Trackers and cookies that load before the consent banner is answered, and
    whether the “reject” button really blocks them, with the fix for your
    banner tool (Cookiebot, Usercentrics, Borlabs Cookie, Complianz and others)
    and Google Tag Manager
  • Checkout: the wording of the order button and a button to withdraw from
    the contract
  • Manufacturer details on product pages (GPSR)
  • Dark patterns: restarting countdowns, pre-ticked paid add-ons, fees added
    late
  • Data flows: servers outside the EU, resources loaded without HTTPS, and
    trackers hidden behind the shop’s own subdomain (CNAME cloaking)

2. One-click fixes in wp-admin. Each one is off until you switch it on
or approve it:

  • Images without alternative text: a list of media library images without
    alt text, with a suggestion from the product or file name. Only the rows
    you tick are saved.
  • Load Google Fonts locally: copies the Google Fonts your theme enqueues to
    your own server once and serves them from there.
  • Load videos and maps only after a click: YouTube, Vimeo and Google Maps
    embeds in your content show a button instead and load only when clicked.
  • WooCommerce order button “Place order with obligation to pay”, in German “Zahlungspflichtig bestellen” (classic checkout).

3. Fixes as a task list. In the konformia.at account, the “Fixes” tab
lists every fix for the shop as a task, ordered by where the work is done:
in your consent tool, in WooCommerce, in the theme, at your domain provider.
Each task has the menu path, a copy button for what to enter (script
address, attribute, DNS record) and a “Fix in WordPress” link that opens the
matching switch on this plugin’s page in your own wp-admin. konformia.at
never changes your site remotely; you click there, logged in as yourself.
A task disappears as soon as the next check no longer finds the problem.

The plugin does not give legal advice and does not check or write legal
texts. Ownership of the shop is proven only through a randomly generated
secret that is served over a publicly readable route of this shop and
matched by konformia.at itself.

With an account at konformia.at you get the fix for every finding as a
task list, a check every week with an e-mail when something changes, a
dashboard and the report as PDF. The account starts as a free 14-day trial
(no card, ends by itself) from the report page.

Usage: under Tools -> Check shop, choose the markets the shop sells to
(EU and/or USA) and click “Check shop now”. The fixes are on the same
page under “Fix now”.

The plugin’s own screens are in German.

External services

This plugin connects to the external service konformia.at to check this
shop technically.

What is sent: this shop’s hostname, the chosen markets (EU and/or USA),
and a randomly generated secret that only proves this plugin is running on
this shop. No customer data, orders, or shop content is transmitted.

When: only when “Check shop now” is actively clicked in wp-admin, and
afterward while the result is being polled.

What for: konformia.at then opens the shop’s public pages like a visitor
would, measures what they load, and returns numbers plus a link to the
report.

The switch “Google Fonts lokal laden” downloads the font files your theme
already uses from fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com once, to store
them on your server. Nothing else is sent to Google.

Provider: konformia.at. Privacy policy:
https://konformia.at/datenschutz
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, or install it as a ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin under “Plugins”.
  3. In wp-admin, go to “Tools -> Check shop”, choose the markets and click
    “Check shop now”.
sections.faq:
Does the check cost anything?

The check is free, one per shop every 30 days. The report shows every
finding with where it was found and how much work it is. The fixes, weekly
checks and the dashboard come with the free 14-day trial (no card),
started with your e-mail address on the report page. After that,
Watchdog and Agentur are paid subscriptions at konformia.at; the trial ends
by itself and is never converted automatically. The one-click fixes in the
plugin are free.

Does the plugin change anything in my shop?

Only what you switch on or approve under “Fix now”: alt texts you
tick are saved to the media library, Google Fonts are served from your
server, embeds load after a click, and the WooCommerce order button gets a
new label. Switching a fix off undoes it; saved alt texts stay. The check
itself writes nothing to the shop.

Why does the market matter?

The duties in the report depend on where the shop sells, not where the
company sits. With “EU” the report shows the EU checks. Checks for the US
are in progress; the report says so.

How does konformia.at know this shop belongs to me?

On activation, the plugin creates a random secret and serves it at
/wp-json/konformia/v1/verify. When a check starts, the plugin sends the
same secret along, and konformia.at fetches the route itself and
compares the two values. Ownership only counts as proven on a match.

Where does the report live?

It sits at a separate, non-discoverable address at konformia.at and is
not copied into the shop.

The plugin reports an error even though the shop is online. Why?

The most common reason: the shop is not publicly reachable, for example
because of a password on the front page, a maintenance page, a firewall,
or a staging environment without a public address. Then konformia.at
cannot reach this shop’s /wp-json/konformia/v1/verify route from outside.

How often can I check a shop before it costs anything?

One check per shop is free for 30 days. Clicking “Check shop now”
again within that time shows the existing report instead of creating a
new one.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • New name: Konformia Shop Scanner: Accessibility, Trackers, Checkout.

1.4.1

  • English and German: the plugin follows the WordPress language (German for de_DE, de_DE_formal, de_AT, de_CH, English otherwise).
  • The order button text follows the shop language.

1.4.0

  • Each fix has its own anchor: the “Fix in WordPress” link in the konformia.at account opens this page with the matching fix highlighted.
  • New one-click fixes under “Fix now”: alt text for media library images (suggestion, saved only when ticked), YouTube/Vimeo/Google Maps embeds load only after a click, WooCommerce order button “Zahlungspflichtig bestellen”.
  • Choose the markets the shop sells to (EU, USA) instead of a country. Existing settings Austria/Germany count as EU.
  • The check no longer covers legal texts; the list of affected legal pages is gone.

1.3.0

  • New switch “Google Fonts lokal laden”: copies the Google Fonts your theme loads to your own server once and serves them from there, so visitors’ IP addresses no longer go to Google. Covers fonts enqueued through WordPress; switching it off removes the copies.

1.2.0

  • Explains what the konformia.at account adds (all findings, weekly checks, dashboard, PDF, seal) and links to the login. The report link now reads “Bericht öffnen”, since without an account it opens the preview.

1.1.0

  • Lists the legal pages (imprint, privacy policy, terms, withdrawal) with open points and links each one to the WordPress editor (“Seite bearbeiten”). The plugin still writes nothing to your site.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
